      {
        "canonical_tex": "and",
        "hash": "6201111b83a0cb5b",
        "id": "eq-478",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "are mutually\nprime. We also know that",
        "hash": "b0c3751dc12092ee",
        "id": "eq-479",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "is equal to",
        "hash": "cb9f40319a5334e0",
        "id": "eq-480",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "modulo",
        "hash": "93401e39d3641332",
        "id": "eq-481",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ". Therefore, we have $",
        "hash": "214a869587ad562b",
        "id": "eq-482",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}\n  \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack k}_q \\cdot \\prod_{i=k}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big)  \n=\n\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{l=1}^{\\mathcal{N}/d-1}\n  \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack ld}_q \\cdot \\prod_{i=ld}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big).",
        "hash": "33579b59c0af4bab",
        "id": "eq-483",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "Replacing",
        "hash": "a1670258ef34698b",
        "id": "eq-484",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "by",
        "hash": "a7e2d26e8d15814d",
        "id": "eq-485",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", we get\n$",
        "hash": "508249560b1b2cd4",
        "id": "eq-486",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{l=1}^{\\mathcal{N}/d-1}\n  \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack ld}_q \\cdot \\prod_{i=ld}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big)\n  =\n\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{l=1}^{\\mathcal{N}/d-1}\n  \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack ld}_q\\prod_{i=0}^{ld-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big) ,",
        "hash": "0108f1a6d564079e",
        "id": "eq-487",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "which is contained in",
        "hash": "cfd00de4b2c3ba05",
        "id": "eq-488",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ".\nHence,",
        "hash": "2600dd2a890a9fed",
        "id": "eq-489",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "is contained in",
        "hash": "afe0a822dba0e710",
        "id": "eq-490",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ".\n\n**Step II:",
        "hash": "eeb002a0d25cabf9",
        "id": "eq-491",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "**\n\nBy Lemma [41](#lem:qi){reference-type=\"ref\" reference=\"lem:qi\"} given\nbelow, we have",
        "hash": "abc58fdda6970356",
        "id": "eq-492",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", which is a\nnon-zero integer and is invertible in",
        "hash": "6b1ba27836a33b13",
        "id": "eq-493",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", so we obtain:\n$",
        "hash": "2df05d20ad84f501",
        "id": "eq-494",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\begin{aligned}\n\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{l=1}^{\\mathcal{N}/d-1}\n  \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack ld}_q\\prod_{i=0}^{ld-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big) \n    &=\n \\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n\\sum_{l=1}^{\\mathcal{N}/d-1}\n  \\Big(\\prod_{i=0}^{ld-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big) \n  =\\\\\n  &=\n   \\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n  \\Big(\\prod_{i=0}^{d-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big).\n \\end{aligned}",
        "hash": "539cc71bf0285d49",
        "id": "eq-495",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "r1\\'",
        "hash": "5daf4b3da0391d99",
        "id": "eq-496",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "r2\\'",
        "hash": "9134c4dadf248ecd",
        "id": "eq-497",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\begin{aligned}\n\\mathcal{I}^\\prime_\\mathcal{N}&= (s^2 q^{-2\\mathcal{N}+2}-1)\\left(\\sum_{k=0}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}\n \\Big({\\mathcal{N}\\brack k+1}_q \\cdot \\prod_{i=1}^{\\mathcal{N}-k-2}(s^2q^{-2k-2i}-1) \\Big)\\right)=\\\\\n &=(s^2 q^{-2\\mathcal{N}+2}-1) \\cdot \\bigcap_{\\text{\\scriptsize$\\begin{matrix}\n d\\mid \\mathcal{N}\\\\ d \\neq 1 \\end{matrix}$}} \\Big(\\Big( \\varphi_d(q^2)\\Big) +\n  \\Big(\\prod_{i=0}^{d-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\Big) \\Big).\n \\end{aligned}",
        "hash": "3cec3c2f98b21de1",
        "id": "eq-498",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "On the other hand, let us recall that\n$",
        "hash": "ab57bd3ef075c35d",
        "id": "eq-499",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde{\\mathcal{J}}_\\mathcal{N}=   \n\\left((s^2 q^{-2\\mathcal{N}+2} - 1) \\cdot\\left(\\varphi_\\mathcal{N}(q^2)\\right)\\right) \\cap\n \\bigcap_{\\text{\\scriptsize$\\begin{matrix}\n d\\mid \\mathcal{N}\\\\ d \\neq 1, \\mathcal{N}\\end{matrix}$}}\n \\left(\\varphi_d(q^2),\\ \\  \\prod_{i=0}^{d-2}(s^2q^{-2i}-1) \\right)",
        "hash": "b3e2d149be6c2161",
        "id": "eq-500",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "The previous relations imply that",
        "hash": "f7afe8c8eb4bb058",
        "id": "eq-501",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "and so we conclude the equality",
        "hash": "7ba1ebd03af81985",
        "id": "eq-502",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ".\n\nNext, we will show that",
        "hash": "6f50da1fd57042ce",
        "id": "eq-503",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "in two\nsteps.\n\n**Step III:",
        "hash": "b0c1e1c4d56b48a1",
        "id": "eq-504",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "**\n\nFor this, we start with the definition of",
        "hash": "1d47ac28d0f01263",
        "id": "eq-505",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ":\n$",
        "hash": "daad7f30fde86f84",
        "id": "eq-506",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\mathcal{C}_\\mathcal{N}= \\sum_{\\substack{i,j=0 \\\\ j+n\\geqslant\\mathcal{N},0\\leqslant n\\leqslant i}}^{\\mathcal{N}-1}\n \\left( {n+j \\brack j}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right) \n \\\\\n =\n \\sum_{i=0}^{\\mathcal{N}-1}\n \\sum_{j=1}^{\\mathcal{N}-1}\n \\sum_{n=\\mathcal{N}-j}^{i}\n \\left( {n+j \\brack j}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right) \n \\\\=\n \\sum_{i=0}^{\\mathcal{N}-1}\n \\sum_{j=0}^{\\mathcal{N}-2}\n \\sum_{n=\\mathcal{N}-j-1}^{i}\n \\left( {n+j+1 \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j-1}-s^{-1}q^{k+j+1}) \\right).",
        "hash": "26fbb33b36128e7d",
        "id": "eq-507",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "For",
        "hash": "ca15ebc05a3c5c13",
        "id": "eq-508",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", $",
        "hash": "460de921a509b0cc",
        "id": "eq-509",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\left( {n+j+1 \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j-1}-s^{-1}q^{k+j+1}) \\right)  \n =\n \\\\\n  \\left( {\\mathcal{N}\\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{\\mathcal{N}-j-2}(sq^{-k-j-1}-s^{-1}q^{k+j+1}) \\right)  \n  =\n  \\\\\n   \\left( {\\mathcal{N}\\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}-j-1}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right).",
        "hash": "217b4a16465582ab",
        "id": "eq-510",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "Therefore, we obtain that",
        "hash": "0bc20908ce7aca68",
        "id": "eq-511",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ".\n\n**Step IV:",
        "hash": "d62a228c792cd23c",
        "id": "eq-512",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "**\n\nFor this last step we are going to show that: $",
        "hash": "55889bc618d848d5",
        "id": "eq-513",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\left( {n+j+1 \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j-1}-s^{-1}q^{k+j+1}) \\right) \n\\in \\mathcal{I}_\\mathcal{N}^\\prime.",
        "hash": "83d94b112f3356c6",
        "id": "eq-514",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "Let",
        "hash": "e947a3d4f4a1b236",
        "id": "eq-515",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ". Then\n$",
        "hash": "0d22b007dbd7890c",
        "id": "eq-516",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\left( {n+j+1 \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(sq^{-k-j-1}-s^{-1}q^{k+j+1}) \\right)\n=\n\\left( {\\mathcal{N}+l \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}+l-j-1}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right).",
        "hash": "d2c17b59359b5b0d",
        "id": "eq-517",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "We show that the above is contained in",
        "hash": "6771e6861f0c1017",
        "id": "eq-518",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "by an induction on",
        "hash": "45e6f4d159acf9f5",
        "id": "eq-519",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ". If",
        "hash": "a0a323def95d4762",
        "id": "eq-520",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", then\nit is contained in",
        "hash": "124675fcd4213353",
        "id": "eq-521",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ". Now we assume that",
        "hash": "7a2cfe1fa9625088",
        "id": "eq-522",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ".\nThen $",
        "hash": "0d22b007dbd7890c",
        "id": "eq-523",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\left( {\\mathcal{N}+l+1 \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}+l-j}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right)\n=\n\\\\\nq^{\\mathcal{N}+l-j}\\left( {\\mathcal{N}+l \\brack j+1}_q \\prod_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}+l-j}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right)\n+\n\\\\\nq^{-j-1}\\left( {\\mathcal{N}+l \\brack j}_q \\prod_{k=1}^{\\mathcal{N}+l-j}(sq^{-k-j}-s^{-1}q^{k+j}) \\right).",
        "hash": "b3de1596c69b7958",
        "id": "eq-524",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "The last two terms are contained in",
        "hash": "2b930a80d56f1d44",
        "id": "eq-525",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "and so",
        "hash": "855120c5d346e350",
        "id": "eq-526",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ". ◻\n:::\n\n::: {#lem:qi .lem}\n**Lemma 41**. *If",
        "hash": "b06a76fd22305764",
        "id": "eq-527",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "and",
        "hash": "6201111b83a0cb5b",
        "id": "eq-528",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "are both multiple of",
        "hash": "da98db3c4bab8aac",
        "id": "eq-529",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": ", then",
        "hash": "aae687415b646286",
        "id": "eq-530",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "is equal to",
        "hash": "cb9f40319a5334e0",
        "id": "eq-531",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "or",
        "hash": "7175517a370b5cd2",
        "id": "eq-532",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "modulo",
        "hash": "93401e39d3641332",
        "id": "eq-533",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "[d + k] = -[k] \\mod \\Phi_d(q^2).",
        "hash": "006ade52e0f80074",
        "id": "eq-534",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\label{eq:quantum integerd}\n\\frac{[ld + d-1][ld+d-2]\\cdots[ld+1]}\n{[d-1][d-2]\\cdots[1]} = (-1)^{l(d-1)}.",
        "hash": "4ba8ac39651b97e9",
        "id": "eq-535",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\label{eq:quantumintegerquotient}\n\\frac{[kd]}{[d]} = \nq^{(k-1)d} + q^{(k-3)d} + \\cdots + q^{-(k-1)d}\n= \\pm k \\mod \\Phi_d(q^2).",
        "hash": "6e20eeb0174541fb",
        "id": "eq-536",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "k = k'd",
        "hash": "095075adbe70c6b5",
        "id": "eq-537",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "l = l'd",
        "hash": "28b1411db6a3a1c4",
        "id": "eq-538",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "eq:quantum integerd",
        "hash": "79c559a77995408f",
        "id": "eq-539",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "eq:quantumintegerquotient",
        "hash": "ead1c9263a5d0f45",
        "id": "eq-540",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "{k'd \\brack l'd}_q \n=\n\\pm \\frac{[k'd][(k'-1)d]\\cdots [(k'-l'+1)d]}\n{[l'd][(l'-1)d]\\cdots[d]}\n=\n\\pm {k' \\brack l'}_1 \\mod \\Phi_d(q^2).",
        "hash": "7a884b93c5a8b9e8",
        "id": "eq-541",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "{k'd \\brack l'd}_q",
        "hash": "9bfe8abc0036033f",
        "id": "eq-542",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\pm {k' \\brack l'}_1",
        "hash": "6050f8e652b0856e",
        "id": "eq-543",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\Phi_d(q^2)",
        "hash": "95076f86b1c1ebaa",
        "id": "eq-544",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde{\\mathcal{J}}_\\mathcal{N}",
        "hash": "5c39f7d1fcbf9014",
        "id": "eq-545",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde\\mathcal{I}_{\\mathcal{N}}",
        "hash": "a49462e1c897c604",
        "id": "eq-546",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde{\\mathcal{J}}_\\mathcal{N}",
        "hash": "5c39f7d1fcbf9014",
        "id": "eq-547",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde{\\mathcal{J}}_\\mathcal{N}\n=\\left( \\varphi_\\mathcal{N}(q^2) \\cdot (s^2 q^{-2\\mathcal{N}+2} - 1)\\right)  \\cap \\bigcap_{\\text{\\scriptsize$\\begin{matrix}\n d\\mid \\mathcal{N}\\\\ d \\neq 1, \\mathcal{N}\\end{matrix}$}}\n \\left(\\varphi_d(q^2), \\frac{s^{2d}-1}{s^2-1} \\right).",
        "hash": "6b79c4a84c26849c",
        "id": "eq-548",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "*\n:::\n\n::: proof\n*Proof.* We recall that $",
        "hash": "f67f648e8ba67bcd",
        "id": "eq-549",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,
        "semantic_tag": "other"
      },
      {
        "canonical_tex": "\\widetilde{\\mathcal{J}}_\\mathcal{N}\n=\\left( \\varphi_\\mathcal{N}(q^2) \\cdot (s^2 q^{-2\\mathcal{N}+2} - 1)\\right)  \\cap \\bigcap_{\\text{\\scriptsize$\\begin{matrix}\n d\\mid \\mathcal{N}\\\\ d \\neq 1, \\mathcal{N}\\end{matrix}$}}\n \\left(\\varphi_d(q^2), \\ \\prod_{i=1}^{d-1}(s^2q^{-2i}-1)  \\right).",
        "hash": "43d5fe5c260d52ac",
        "id": "eq-550",
        "mathml": null,
        "section_id": null,

Both stated representations (over the\ninterpolation ring and over the maximal ring) are instances of this single fact,\nhence the conjunction.\n-/\ntheorem InterpolatingAJ_tex_thm_19154\n    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]\n    {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R' M']\n    {G : Type*} [Group G]\n    (ρ : G →* (M ≃ₗ[R] M)) (N : Submodule R M)\n    (hN : ∀ g : G, N.map (ρ g) = N)\n    (ρ' : G →* (M' ≃ₗ[R'] M')) (N' : Submodule R' M')\n    (hN' : ∀ g : G, N'.map (ρ' g) = N') :\n    (∃ σ : G →* (M ⧸ N ≃ₗ[R] M ⧸ N),\n        ∀ (g : G) (m : M),\n          σ g (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (ρ g m)) ∧\n    (∃ σ' : G →* (M' ⧸ N' ≃ₗ[R'] M' ⧸ N'),\n        ∀ (g : G) (m : M'),\n          σ' g (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (ρ' g m)) := by\n  refine ⟨⟨MonoidHom.mk' (fun g => Submodule.Quotient.equiv N N (ρ g) (hN g)) ?_, ?_⟩,\n          ⟨MonoidHom.mk' (fun g => Submodule.Quotient.equiv N' N' (ρ' g) (hN' g)) ?_, ?_⟩⟩\n  · intro a b\n    ext x\n    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective N x\n    simp [map_mul]\n  · intro g m\n    simp\n  · intro a b\n    ext x\n    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective N' x\n    simp [map_mul]\n  · intro g m\n    simp\n\nend GrokRxiv\n",

More precisely:\n    (1) the image of the level-N quantum trace OmegaTrace_N(L)(q,s) in LiTilde_N\n        is a knot invariant; and\n    (2) if LiTilde_N' is any quotient of Li in which OmegaTrace_N(beta_n) is a\n        knot invariant, then the quotient onto LiTilde_N' factors through\n        LiTilde_N.\n\nThe upstream semantic IR classifies every predicate below as an\n`uninterpreted_predicate`, and the obligation ships with an empty `dependencies`\nlist. Per the role contract the proof is left to fail honestly\nrather than fabricated, weakened, or closed with sorry/admit/axiom.\n-/\n\ntheorem InterpolatingAJ_tex_coro_57941\n    {R Rj Ra : Type}\n    (OrientedKnot : Type)\n    (universalInvariant : Nat → OrientedKnot → R)   -- Ω̃_N(L), Laurent in q and s\n    (specJones : Nat → R → Rj)                       -- restriction s = q^{1-N}\n    (specADO : Nat → R → Ra)                         -- restriction q = ξ_N\n    (colouredJones : Nat → OrientedKnot → Rj)        -- J_N(L, q)\n    (ado : Nat → OrientedKnot → Ra)                  -- Φ_N(L, s)\n    (N : Nat) (L : OrientedKnot) :\n    (specJones N (universalInvariant N L) = colouredJones N L) ∧\n    (specADO N (universalInvariant N L) = ado N L) := by\n  refine ⟨?jones, ?ado⟩\n  -- goal jones: specialising the universal invariant at s = q^{1-N} yields J_N.\n  -- goal ado  : specialising at q = ξ_N yields Φ_N.\n  -- Both are the paper's theorem and cannot be discharged for abstract data;\n  -- closing them honestly requires the omitted constructions of Ω̃_N, J_N, Φ_N\n  -- and the two specialisation maps. The goals are intentionally left open so\n  -- that review records an honest failure instead of a fabricated proof.\n\nend GrokRxiv\n",

            "None of the objects (OrientedKnot, Ω̃_N, J_N, Φ_N, the specialisation maps, ξ_N) exist in Mathlib and no definitions/dependencies were supplied, so they are modelled as abstract typed parameters carrying the paper's signatures; the conjunction of the two specialisation equalities matches the theorem IR exactly.",

        "verdict": "NARROWED",
        "verified_statement": "import Mathlib\n\nopen scoped BigOperators\n\nnamespace GrokRxiv\n\ntheorem InterpolatingAJ_tex_lem_72872\n    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (I : Fin n → Ideal R)\n    (hco : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → I i ⊔ I j = ⊤) :\n    ⨅ i, I i = ∏ i, I i := by\n  -- For coprime ideals, the product equals the intersection.\n  have mul_eq_inf : ∀ J K : Ideal R, J ⊔ K = ⊤ → J * K = J ⊓ K := by\n    intro J K h\n    refine le_antisymm Ideal.mul_le_inf ?_\n    intro x hx\n    rw [Submodule.mem_inf] at hx\n    obtain ⟨hxJ, hxK⟩ := hx\n    have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ J ⊔ K := by rw [h]; exact Submodule.mem_top\n    rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at h1\n    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := h1\n    have hxeq : x * y + x * z = x := by rw [← mul_add, hyz, mul_one]\n    rw [← hxeq]\n    refine add_mem ?_ ?_\n    · rw [mul_comm x y]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hy hxK\n    · exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hxJ hz\n  -- The product over any finset of pairwise-coprime ideals equals their infimum.\n  have key : ∀ s : Finset (Fin n), (∏ i ∈ s, I i) = s.inf I := by\n    intro s\n    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_\n    · simp [Ideal.one_eq_top]\n    · intro a t ha ih\n      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.inf_insert, ih]\n      have hcop : I a ⊔ t.inf I = ⊤ := by\n        rw [← ih, ← Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq]\n        refine IsCoprime.prod_right ?_\n        intro i hi\n        rw [Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq]\n        exact hco a i (by rintro rfl; exact ha hi)\n      exact mul_eq_inf (I a) (t.inf I) hcop\n  -- Convert the type-indexed infimum into the `Finset.univ` infimum.\n  have hconv : (⨅ i, I i) = Finset.univ.inf I := by\n    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_\n    · exact Finset.le_inf (fun i _ => iInf_le I i)\n    · exact le_iInf (fun i => Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))\n  rw [hconv]\n  exact (key Finset.univ).symm\n\nend GrokRxiv\n"

{
  "audience": "Knot theorists and quantum topology researchers; mathematicians working with quantum groups, braid group representations, and knot invariants; researchers interested in unifying different families of quantum invariants and exploring connections to 3-manifold topology.",
  "key_contributions": [
    "Construction of level N unified invariants for any level N ≥ 2, represented in maximal quotient rings of the polynomial ring Q[q^±2, s^±2]",
    "Proof that for prime N, the interpolation ring gives the maximal quotient allowing knot invariants from the N-part of the Verma module",
    "Explicit interpolation formula showing the unified invariant equals a combination of coloured Jones and ADO invariants",
    "Extension to non-prime N with a richer maximal ring structure that recovers both classical invariants but potentially contains additional information",
    "Demonstration that the universal invariants specialize to both semi-simple (Jones) and non-semisimple (ADO) invariants through coefficient specialization"
  ],
  "plain_language_summary": "Quantum knot invariants are algebraic tools that help distinguish knots by assigning polynomial or other algebraic objects to them. The coloured Jones polynomials and ADO (Akutsu-Deguchi-Ohtsuki) invariants are two fundamental families of such invariants derived from quantum group representation theory, each revealing different geometric information about knots. This paper constructs new \"level N universal invariants\" that unify both families by leveraging the Verma module—an infinite-dimensional representation of the quantum group U_q(sl_2)—and examining how it acts on braids when restricted to finite-dimensional subspaces.\n\nThe authors work over polynomial rings in two variables and define a maximal quotient ring structure for each level N. For prime levels, this quotient ring is relatively simple and captures an interpolation formula between coloured Jones and ADO invariants. For non-prime levels, the quotient ring has richer structure with potentially new information not visible in the classical sequences of invariants. The paper proves that their invariants are maximal—no larger quotient ring can produce well-defined knot invariants from the Verma module at that level.",
  "tldr": "A construction of universal quantum knot invariants that unify and extend the coloured Jones and ADO polynomials through quantum traces on quotients of the Verma module."
}
